learning_outcomes.description: Formulate problem spaces and apply heuristic search (A*, Greedy Best-First) and Minimax with Alpha-Beta pruning.
Model constraint satisfaction problems (CSP) and solve them using backtracking and arc consistency (AC-3).
Perform probabilistic inference using Bayesian networks and construct naive Bayes classifiers.

weeks.topic: Intelligent Agents, Environments, and Uninformed State Space Search (BFS, DFS, UCS).
Heuristic Search, Greedy Search, A* Optimality, and Admissible Heuristics.
Adversarial Search, Minimax Algorithm, Alpha-Beta Pruning, and Evaluation Functions.
Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSP), Backtracking, and Forward Checking.
Knowledge Representation and Propositional Logic Inference.
Uncertainty, Probability Axioms, and Conditional Independence.
Bayesian Networks, Exact Inference by Enumeration, and Variable Elimination.
Supervised Learning Foundations, Decision Trees, and Overfitting.
Linear Classification, Perceptron, and Introduction to Deep Learning.
